entities.name: Sidelink reset configuration procedure
entities.description: Procedure where the UE releases/clears current sidelink radio configuration, releases sidelink DRBs, and resets sidelink specific MAC for a specific destination.

entities.name: RRCReconfigurationSidelink
entities.description: RRC message used to configure sidelink parameters including sidelink reset configuration.

entities.name: sl-ResetConfig
entities.description: Information element in RRCReconfigurationSidelink that triggers sidelink reset configuration.

entities.name: Sidelink DRB release procedure
entities.description: Procedure to release sidelink DRBs according to specified conditions and operations.

entities.name: sl-ResetConfig included in RRCReconfigurationSidelink
entities.description: Condition where sl-ResetConfig IE is present in RRCReconfigurationSidelink message, triggering sidelink reset.

entities.name: Release sidelink radio configuration
entities.description: Behavior where UE releases/clears current sidelink radio configuration received in RRCReconfigurationSidelink.

entities.name: Reset sidelink specific MAC
entities.description: Behavior where UE resets the sidelink specific MAC entity for the destination.

entities.name: Sidelink radio link failure detected
entities.description: Condition where sidelink radio link failure is detected for a specific destination, triggering DRB/SRB release.
